status: Exploratory follow-up explicitly requested after four-way test results were inspected. Parent artifacts preserved. No fresh blind-test claim.

normalization.method: Per-feature training-only mean/std over unique photo-target rows. Same transform applied to train/validation/test. Minimum std0.001. Preserve the original CLIP branch.
normalization.initialization: First dense weights/biases reparameterized to retain initial unscaled inference scores. No LayerNorm or BatchNorm.
normalization.l2: True zero-centered L2 on transformed dense kernels, excluding biases. Coordinate scaling therefore changes the regularization prior; document that interaction.

selection: Seed78123 across both arms: maximize sum of validation-selected first-choice counts, then minimize mean validation pairwise loss. Exact ties prefer smaller learning rate. L2 remains0.0001, isolating the learning-rate search; no new lambda sweep.
checkpoints: Complete600epochs. Save final and best validation first-choice checkpoint, then loss tie-break. No test-dependent retuning.
cohorts: Fixed and validation-tuned learning rates for each family, three seeds, both arms. Reuse identical config fits. All fixed/tuned fits and settings frozen before scoring their test outcomes.
checks: Same dense fitting/optimizer kernel as parent study. Finite differences on normalized parameters, initial-function preservation, frozen train-only transform, same-kernel eight-gallery overfit, independent JS native/folded inference. Original data unchanged.
acceptance: Offline diagnostic only. Compare first-choice results as primary; lower pairwise loss alone is not evidence of better image selection. Same21testmeanings acrossseeds, not independent datasets.
